summary: Official EIC page confirms the 2026 Accelerator is active, with short proposals accepted any time and full-proposal batching dates still upcoming in 2026.

proposed_event.name: EIC Accelerator 2026
proposed_event.description: EU deep-tech funding for startups and SMEs, with grants, equity investment, coaching, mentoring and networking.

dates.date_range_text: Short proposals accepted any time and evaluated monthly; 2026 full-proposal cutoffs include Jul 8, Sep 2, and Nov 4 at 5pm Brussels time.

sources.title: EIC Accelerator - European Innovation Council
sources.supports: Confirms the EIC Accelerator supports startups and SMEs with grant funding below EUR 2.5 million, EUR 1-10 million investment, coaching, mentoring, networking, eligibility, and 2026 budgets.

sources.title: EIC Accelerator application section - European Innovation Council
sources.supports: Confirms short proposals may be submitted any time, are batched monthly on the first Tuesday at 5pm Brussels time, and full-proposal 2026 batching dates include 2026-07-08, 2026-09-02, and 2026-11-04.

sources.title: EU Funding & Tenders Portal - HORIZON-EIC-2026-ACCELERATOR-01
sources.supports: Official application portal topic linked from the EIC Accelerator page for 2026 submissions.

notes: Set application_close to the next future full-proposal batching date after 2026-06-09: 2026-07-08.
Program start, end, and demo day are null because the official page describes application/evaluation cadence rather than a fixed accelerator cohort runtime.
Location is modeled as virtual/EU-wide because the official process is submitted through the Funding and Tenders portal and eligibility spans EU Member States and Horizon Europe associated countries.
